safer.title: Safer play
safer.intro: Euros are for ages 18 and up only. Here you set your limits and can self-exclude whenever you want.
safer.age: We mark 18+ by birth year; it isn't an identity check.
safer.excludedNote: You have self-exclusion active. Euros are turned off in your account until {date}.
safer.self.title: Self-exclusion
safer.self.body: You stop being able to play with euros for the period you choose. It can't be shortened before it ends.
safer.self.confirm: Are you sure? You won't be able to undo it until it ends.
safer.limits.title: Deposit limits
safer.limits.body: Cap what you add. Lowering is immediate; raising takes a few days.
safer.help.title: Is play stopping being play?
safer.help.body: Ask for help. There are National Health System resources and support organizations.
